身体の一貫性：
身長約166cm。脚が長く、自信のある姿勢。健康的で軽く引き締まった成人の砂時計型体型。胸は自然に豊かで、胸郭に釣り合う現実的な付け根の幅、前方への厚み、柔らかな重さと重力を持つ。腰はくびれているが現実的で、ヒップと臀部は適度にふっくらして少し大きめの丸みがあり、骨盤から太ももへ自然につながる。視点が変わっても身長、胸郭、腰、骨盤、ヒップの量感、手足の比率を保つ。普通の不透明な衣服と自然な布の張りを使う。持ち上げる胸の補正、胸の谷間、パッド、極端な締め付け、インプラントのような球形、不可能な細い腰、誇張したヒップ、BBL風の輪郭にはしない。

撮影状況：

衣装：

promptTranslations.en:
Character Identity:
A fictional 30-year-old Japanese adult woman. A cheerful bakery café manager with a polished, playful influencer-like presence. She has a petite, softly rounded oval face, gently plump cheeks, and a rounded chin. Large, expressive, dark brown double-lidded eyes, intermediate between almond-shaped and round, with outer corners that droop very slightly. Neatly groomed, soft arched eyebrows, a natural straight nose with a slightly rounded tip, and soft, plump lips with naturally upturned corners. Fair, warm-neutral Japanese skin showing realistic pores, faint natural flushing, subtle freckles across the nose, and slight natural asymmetry. There is a single tiny beauty mark located beneath the outer corner of her anatomical left eye. Her signature smile is a bright, playful, tooth-showing smile that forms dimples on both cheeks. Hair is a shoulder-length, smooth straight layered bob. The parting is slightly off-center, with ends naturally curling inward. The surface layer, roots, crown, part line, bangs, and upper hair framing the face are a uniform, glossy black to dark charcoal. A cool smoky gray to graphite silver peekaboo under-color exists exclusively beneath this dark surface layer, visible only around the tucked-behind-the-ear sections and the inner lower tips. Do not render a center-part split, half-and-half color blocking, a center stripe, gray roots or crown, face-framing gray highlights, gradients, or full-head gray. Modern influencer-style makeup featuring defined eyelashes, subtle taupe eyeliner, and rose-beige lips, without plastic-like skin smoothing. Thin, round black metal or gunmetal glasses are an optional signature accessory. Maintain the fictional adult facial features, face shape, freckles, beauty mark placement, dimples, black surface hair, peekaboo color placement, hair length, and mature adult age described here, without resembling any identifiable real person.

Body Consistency:
Height approximately 166 cm. Long legs with a confident posture. A healthy, lightly toned adult hourglass figure. Breasts are naturally full, with realistic root width proportional to the ribcage, forward volume, and soft weight responding to gravity. The waist is tapered yet realistic; hips and buttocks are moderately full with a slightly larger curve, transitioning naturally from pelvis to thighs. Maintain height, ribcage, waist, pelvis, hip volume, and limb proportions consistently across varying perspectives. Use ordinary, opaque clothing and natural fabric tension. Do not render push-up breast correction, exaggerated cleavage, padding, extreme corseting, implant-like spheres, impossibly narrow waists, exaggerated hips, or BBL-style contours.

Shooting Context:
21:15. A woman who returned home relaxes on the sofa, capturing the final shot of her day off using her propped-up smartphone timer. She is lazily watching TV.

Location and Background:
A lived-in fabric sofa at home, slightly worn. Cushions and a rolled-up blanket. On the low coffee table sits a purchased charcoal ceramic mug with a white interior and a round handle.

Outfit:
A thin charcoal cotton camisole and light gray short cotton loungewear shorts. Both are opaque. Barefoot, wearing thin, black-rimmed round glasses.

Pose and Action:
Lying on her side on the sofa, resting her head on a cushion. Knees are gently bent, with the upper hand resting against a remote control. The lower arm rests naturally beside the cushion. Her weight rests fully on the sofa without arching her back. A relaxed, closed-mouth expression looking toward the TV, without turning back toward the camera.

Composition and Angle of View:
A pulled-back everyday snapshot taken from a smartphone placed diagonally behind the sofa, encompassing the room and the entire sofa. Distance approximately 2.5 m, height 1.2 m, standard 1x lens. A full-body view relaxing sideways along with her profile in equal proportion. Framing from head to toes with breathing room, avoiding close-ups on any single body part, capturing both the sofa and the low table. The subject occupies within 75 percent of the image width. Background margins of at least 10 percent of the frame width are kept beyond the tips of the toes and the top of the head, with the left and right ends of the sofa fully contained within the frame.
Output only a single, undivided image with a final size of 1086×1448 px and a 3:4 aspect ratio.

Lighting and Atmosphere:
Warm interior lighting overlaid with the dim, cool glow of the television. Deep gaps in the sofa and the rear of the room remain naturally dark.

Photo Texture:
Depict a single, minimally processed HEIC photo taken with the standard camera app of an ordinary smartphone. Do not confuse character, body, and hair geometry with surface finish. Adhere to a single camera-specified autofocus plane; do not relight, denoise, or sharpen only the distant face. Details soften continuously with distance. Within the recognizable face, preserve broad tonal variations simultaneously—warm hues on one cheek, uneven sheen on the T-zone, differing under-eye tones, and faint redness on the nose—without drawing sharp pores on the distant face. On close, resolvable skin, preserve non-repeating low-contrast tonal shifts, compression-induced redness, crease shadows, and sparse pore variations. Present makeup as real pigment with slightly uneven edges; maintain natural tonal differences between lips and teeth. Maintain uneven exposure and white balance, unlifted shadows, stray flyaway hairs, casual off-center framing, shadow noise, subtle sharpening near the focal plane, and typical HEIC compression artifacts. Capture a frame that feels like an unedited personal camera roll snapshot.

Mandatory Conditions:
Output only a single, undivided smartphone photo of an adult woman matching all scene specifications. It must meet both the scene acceptance criteria and natural smartphone photo quality standards.

Everyday life of a single fictional 30-year-old adult woman.
Acceptance Criteria:
1) A sense of relaxation conveyed from behind, with a natural profile visible beyond.
2) A full-body composition encompassing head to toe. Ordinary clothing worn naturally, with no arched lower back.
3) Maintain adult female facial features, hairstyle, round glasses, and physique.
4) Clearly distinct from seated poses or direct camera-facing expressions of previous scenes.
5) Natural resolution and material differences according to distance from the AF plane, with no selective face retouching.

A lived-in home setting.

Clothing worn normally. Black shoulder-length bob with gray peekaboo color around the ears and lower layer.

Natural lateral recumbent pose. Exactly two arms, two legs, and natural fingers and physical contact. Smiling and dimples are characteristics of laughing; no smiling in this scene.

Autofocus fixed to a single depth plane containing the face and cushion. One standalone vertical 3:4 image.
Only one image. Preserve the specified aspect ratio and full-framing requirements.

Natural lateral vignetting and exposure falloff.

Only a single AF tier. No selective facial exposure compensation, relighting, skin smoothing, or enhancement. Maintain broad tonal shifts on distant facial features, irregular variations on near skin, and localized smartphone processing artifacts.

Depict only a single clearly adult fictional woman as the sole subject of an undivided single photograph. One head, one face, exactly two anatomically connected arms, and naturally shaped hands. An additional person's hand in the foreground is allowed only if explicitly stated in the scene and props, clearly separated from her body. No text, panels, duplicate figures, or alternate angles.
